data.summary: Wohnbau Beispielgrund eG, Johanna Beispielacker's housing cooperative, has assigned her the apartment at Siedlungsweg 18, ground floor right, starting 1 January 2027, and encloses the usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag) in duplicate for signature. The signed copy must be returned within 14 working days of the letter's date (18 November 2026).
data.explanation: Your housing cooperative has allocated you a new apartment starting 1 January 2027. Two copies of the usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag) were enclosed with this letter - sign them and send one copy back to the cooperative by the deadline shown (the app calculates it as 14 working days, Monday to Saturday, from the letter's date, excluding Sundays and public holidays). The letter does not say what happens if you miss this deadline, but delays could jeopardise the apartment assignment, so it is best to return it promptly. Keep your own signed copy for your records.
